description: Fix critical performance issue: TypeScript compiler (3.5MB) bundled in critical-ui chunk, clean up index.html bloat, remove unused imports, and fix React Hook dependency warnings that cause bugs
steps: In src/components/PreviewPanel.tsx, the line `import * as ts from 'typescript'` imports the ENTIRE TypeScript compiler (3.5MB) into the critical rendering path. Refactor to use dynamic import: create an async function `transpileTypeScript(code)` that does `const ts = await import('typescript')` only when jsEditorMode is 'typescript' or 'tsx'. This is the #1 priority fix since it alone accounts for the 3.5MB critical-ui chunk.

In index.html, the meta keywords tag (starting around line 25) is absurdly bloated with thousands of spam keywords making the HTML 86KB. Trim the meta keywords to a reasonable 20-30 relevant keywords. Also remove the excessive content after line ~50 that contains the full keywords spam. Keep the core SEO tags (title, description, OG tags, favicon) but reduce the file from 976 lines to under 100 lines.

In src/App.tsx, remove unused imports: SaveStatusIndicator (line 7), the duplicate EnhancedConsole lazy import (line 23 - it's already lazy-loaded in TabbedRightPanel), Code2/MessageSquare/Mic/LayoutTemplate/BarChart3/CheckCircle/Zap from lucide-react (line 2 - some of these are used in the JSX but Code2 is used in EditorPanel calls so check usage). Also remove unused variables: resetCode, handleUndo, handleRedo, handleManualSave, handleExtensionsToggle, handleKeyboardShortcutsToggle.

Fix React Hook dependency warnings that cause actual bugs: (a) In src/App.tsx useEffect for voice commands (around line 392), wrap handleCommand/handleFormat* in useCallback or include them as deps. (b) In src/components/PreviewPanel.tsx useEffect (line 276), extract `autoRunJS ? javascript : ''` to a variable and include refreshPreview in deps or wrap with useCallback. (c) In src/App.tsx useEffect for project sync (line 342-362), the missing deps cause stale closures.

Fix the type mismatch in src/components/AIChatAssistant.tsx: the prop `externalLibraries` is typed as `string[]` but App.tsx passes `ExternalLibrary[]` (object array). Change the interface to accept `ExternalLibrary[]` from '../services/externalLibraryService' and update the context building to map library names.
Remove src/App_new.tsx (dead code file, never imported anywhere).

In vite.config.ts, update manualChunks to NOT put PreviewPanel in critical-ui (since it's now separate from the TypeScript compiler). Add 'typescript' to its own chunk so it only loads when needed for TS/TSX mode.
acceptance_criteria: Build succeeds with 'bunx vite build' and the critical-ui chunk is under 500KB (was 3.5MB)
index.html is under 100 lines and still has proper SEO meta tags (title, description, OG tags)
ESLint unused-vars errors for SaveStatusIndicator, EnhancedConsole (duplicate), resetCode, handleUndo, handleRedo, handleManualSave are resolved
The AIChatAssistant component accepts ExternalLibrary[] instead of string[] for externalLibraries prop
App still builds and the preview panel still works (TypeScript transpilation is async/lazy)
verification: Run 'bunx vite build' and verify no build errors and critical-ui chunk is under 500KB
Run 'bunx eslint src/App.tsx' and confirm unused import errors are resolved
Check index.html line count is under 100
